chunks: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn Uqda said: Muhammad ibn al-Mufaddal ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurara narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from al-Fadl ibn Yasar, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah saying:

When our Qa'im rises, he will face from ignorance more severely than what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) faced from the ignorance of the pre-Islamic age. I said: 'How is that?' He said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) came to people while they were worshipping stones, rocks, sticks, and carved wood. And when our Qa'im rises, he comes to people and they all interpret the Book of Allah for themselves, using it as evidence against him.' Then he said: 'By Allah, his justice will enter the insides of their houses just as heat and cold enter.'

key_terms.الحر والقر: Heat and cold (metaphor for natural, inevitable penetration)

ai.seo_question: How does the ignorance faced by the Qa'im differ from that faced by the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights that the Qa'im’s challenge is more subtle than the Prophet’s, as he confronts those who weaponize subjective Quranic interpretation (ta'wil) against him rather than worshipping physical idols. This distinction underscores the Shia scholarly view that the greatest opposition to the Mahdi arises from intellectual and theological distortion within the community. His justice will penetrate their innermost lives, transforming them as naturally and inevitably as heat and cold.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (1) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed bin Oqda narrated from Muhammad bin al-Mufadhdhal bin Ibraheem from Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Zurara from Muhammad bin Marwan that al-Fudhayl bin Yasar had said: I heard Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) saying:

“When our Qa’im appears, he will receive harms from the ignorant people more and bitterer than that the Prophet (S) had received from the ignorant people of the pre-Islamic age.” I said: “How is that?” He said: “The Prophet (S) came to people while they used to worship sculptured stone and wood whereas when al-Qa’im comes to people, they will protest against him by interpreting the Book of Allah according to their fancies. By Allah, he (al-Qa’im) will insert his justice into their houses like the entering of hot and cold.”
